note: Zoom on the big wall clock corner of the lime-green gym (cartoon style, wall bars, blue mat): the time prepositions. avant (boy racing his red toy van over the chalk line before the others), depuis (peewee footballer waiting on the bench since breakfast, cobweb on his boot), pendant (girl swinging her gold pendant like the clock's pendulum), jusque (boy pouring juice right up to the brim). Prepositions have no gender (divider null). The blank board on the wall is the sign. No painted back link: strip Back returns to the gym.
